_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Wachiwiri pa gridi ya {width}x{height}.
Iwe {player_id} wachiwiri. Njira zokwana: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kapena w/s/a/d.
Lengo: kupita patsogolo wina wake. Njira zokwana zikukonza; kukana pa mpaka kukonza; magonjwa okhatokhati akukonza awiri.

board.after_moves: Board pambuyo pa kusuntha nthawi imodzi: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Wosewera {player_id} anamwalira chifukwa cha kusuntha kosayenera.

outcome.turn_limit: Kufikira malire a kutembenuka - wopulumuka kwa nthaŵi yaitali koposa amapambana.
